description: Kernel.panic/1 and its extern fz_panic/1 get one activation per exception type raised: 12 activations and about 115 jobs on the OptionParser distiller (tools/distill-telemetry.exs over tests/distill_telemetry/main_returns_one.jsonl, interp). Neither body reads the value. Declaring the parameter any, or ascribing any at the call, leaves the count unchanged (measured). Wanted: one activation of each, whatever is raised. Nearest existing ticket: fz-sc8.143.
title: panic/1 is analysed once, not once per exception type
